coverage.notes: Deer (mule & black-tailed). Source: CDFW Deer Harvest Report Table 1 for each season 2020-2025 (hunter tag reports in ALDS; excludes PLM / Section 554 landowner harvest). One row per zone (A, B1-B6, C1-C4, D3-D19, X1-X12; unit = zone as printed) or per additional/archery hunt (unit = hunt = CDFW hunt code, e.g. A22, G1, J10, M6, MA1), plus CDFW's Statewide row. harvest/harvestMale/harvestFemale = CDFW 'Total Estimated' / 'Estimated Bucks' / 'Estimated Does' (reported harvest corrected for the non-reporting rate); reported counts, tag quota and non-reporting rate are in each row note. successPct = CDFW 'Percent Hunter Success' = total estimated kill / tags issued. B, C and D3-5 tags are valid in any zone of their group, so for those zones quota, tags issued and success (and in 2020-2021 the non-reporting rate) are group totals printed on each zone row, while harvest is zone-specific. licenses = tags issued, printed only in the 2020-2022 reports (left null for group zones, where it is a group total). hunters is null: CDFW does not publish hunters afield. Hunt names (unitNames) are CDFW's 2026 season titles; G8 (dropped after 2022) uses the 2022 drawing-table title. Antler-class tables (Table 2) are not loaded. California has no whitetail deer season.

Source: CDFW Elk Hunt Statistics PDFs 2020-2022, one row per hunt code (unit = hunt = CDFW hunt code) plus the table total as Statewide. Roosevelt, Rocky Mountain and tule elk; the subspecies column printed in the 2022 table is carried into unitNames and row notes. harvest = reported harvest; successPct = CDFW success rate (reported harvest / tag quota). licenses = tags issued (printed only in 2022). Tag quota, applicants and tags reported are in notes; hunter counts are not published. Preference-point-only code 499 and hunts printed with dashes only (2022: 333 Alameda, 334 Santa Clara) are omitted. GAP: CDFW has not posted 2023, 2024 or 2025 elk hunt statistics (wildlife.ca.gov/Hunting/Elk lists 2004-2022 as of 2026-10-31); the elk tooth-age PDFs for 2023-2024 list only submitted teeth and are not harvest totals, so they are not used.

Source: CDFW Pronghorn Hunt Statistics PDFs 2020-2023, one row per hunt code (710-790 zone hunts, 700 fund-raising) plus the table total as Statewide. harvest = reported harvest; licenses = tags issued; quota, applicants and tags reported in notes. successPct as printed: 2022-2023 CDFW defines it as reported harvest / quota; in 2020-2021 the printed % equals harvest / tags issued. GAP: 2024 and 2025 pronghorn hunt statistics are not posted as of 2026-10-31. CDFW's ArcGIS 'Pronghorn Harvest Dashboard' layer of reported kill locations was checked but not used: its 2023 record count (140) does not match the 124 reported harvest in CDFW's 2023 hunt statistics.

Nelson desert bighorn sheep, ram-only general-method hunts (Sierra Nevada and Peninsular bighorn are not hunted). CDFW publishes per-hunt 'Hunter Success (%)' with applicants and tag quotas in the 'Tag Drawing Statistics' table on wildlife.ca.gov/Hunting/Bighorn-Sheep and replaces it every year: 2025 is read from the live page, 2020-2024 from Internet Archive captures of the same CDFW page. Harvest and hunter counts are not published, so harvest and hunters are null (not derived from success x quota). Fund-raising sheep tags are not in the table. Hunt 510 (Zone 10) was split into 512/513 and Zone 7 into 507/511 from 2025.

Black bear, general (OTC) bear tags; statewide season closes when 1,700 bears are reported or on the last Sunday of December. Units are counties as printed by CDFW (upper case); CDFW reports bear harvest by county, not by hunt zone. 2020: county table + statewide (2020 Bear Take Report). 2021-2023: CDFW published only a combined 2021-2023 Interim Take Report; its county table and sex split are 3-year totals and are NOT loaded as single years. Per-year statewide take 2021/2022/2023 is taken from the data labels of CDFW's annual-take chart (sums to the 3,915 stated in text). 2024: county table + statewide from the 2025 Black Bear Program Annual Report (published July 2026, which reports the 2024 season). GAP: the 2025 season bear report is not published as of 2026-10-31. licenses = bear tags sold; hunter counts not published.

Wild turkey (general OTC upland game licenses; harvest is estimated from CDFW's Upland Game Bird Harvest Survey, not counted). Rows are per season: 'Fall season' (year = fall year) and 'Spring season' (year = spring year), Statewide from each survey's Table 1 and by county (unit = county name as printed) from the 2020-21 (Table 2) and 2022-23 (Table 4) surveys; hunters, harvest and daysHunted are CDFW estimates. Counties CDFW lists as 0/0/0 or blank are omitted. Survey seasons covered: Fall 2020, Spring 2021, Fall 2022, Spring 2023, Fall 2023, Spring 2024. GAPS: no survey for Fall 2021/Spring 2022 (CDFW ran the survey biennially) and none yet for Fall 2024 onward. The 2023-24 county table (Table 5) is not loaded: its first row (Alameda) repeats the statewide totals and several counties are visibly misaligned, so county values cannot be assigned reliably. Draw turkey hunts (e.g. on wildlife areas) have no published harvest.
